item.description:
Diane Keaton was an American actress. She was known for her leading film roles and distinctive fashion style. She rose to international prominence with her first major film role as Kay Adams in The Godfather (1972), a role she reprised in its sequels, Part II (1974), and Part III (1990). She collaborated frequently with Woody Allen, appearing in eight of his films, including Annie Hall (1977), for which she won the Academy Ward for Best Actress.
